item.title: Stage North’s Double Feature Radio Show auditions
item.description: Stage North's production of 9 to 5 still has shows tonight at tomorrow night at the NPCC (get your tickets now at npcc.bc.ca), but they're also holding auditions for their next show that will be performed in May. JP is here to talk about "War of The Worlds" and "Sleepwalker", a pair of radio shows he's looking to perform live with actors and live sound effects. Auditions are Feb 21, 22, and 28 from 12-4pm at the Stage North Space. The post Stage North’s Double Feature Radio Show auditions appear

item.title: Best Buddy – Feb 24 – Walter
item.description: This Week's new Best Buddy is WALTER! He’s a 3.5 year old Lab/Chesapeake cross. He’s a lively and adventurous dog who is on a quest to find his forever home, and the ideal companion for an active family who loves to explore the great outdoors. Whether it’s long walks, exhilarating hikes, or fun-filled car rides, Walter is always up for an adventure! If you think that Walter could be your new best buddy, please contact the NP SPCA The post Best Buddy – Feb 24 – Walter appeared first on MooseMedia
